seat_card_v2.cover_meter: 5 punch dots RIGHT of frame: r=3, pitch=12, 6px gap from tile edge (px = x+48); solid=cover, punched = lasting ring 1px @0.30 alpha; RED when shown<=2; +1 = stamp t:0->1 170ms Back.easeOut; -1 = alpha->0.25 60ms then ring; FULL5 = pulse A: per-dot alpha *= 1-max(0,1-|t*6-0.5-k|*1.4)*0.75, cycle 1800ms, continuous, bottom->top
seat_card_v2.chips: LEFT of frame, bx = x-52 (5px gap; leftmost ring seat x~60 lands at screen edge 0); BARE glyphs no boxes: sedated = circle r7 stroke2 + diagonal slash; dirt = serif ! style(15); placer monograms stacked under ! at style(9.6) (~80% of plate name), spacing: sedated->! +25, !->tags +17, tag pitch height+3; chips setVisible(false) DURING stampSeat (audit fix); dead = no chips
seat_card_v2.plates: frame-width w2=39, ny = y+61 (gap22), h2=13; team A (RED, plate 0xffffff) = BOX: white fill, black serif style(12) no stroke; team B (BLUE) = RULES: white serif + 2 hairlines at ny+-13; FFA = bare name only; dead = gray #666666 + strike line; name letterSpacing 2
seat_card_v2.frames: all 1px; team A alpha 1.0, team B alpha 0.5 (THEME.TEAMS fa); active seat alpha 1 vs idle 0.55, multiplied by fa
seat_card_v2.removed: heart pips, tally sticks, plate rectangles, chipT text, strike line object

design_constants.beat_pacing: READ = 1.6 (scene.js) — toast decode 440*R hold(1400)*R out 480*R, stampSeat hold 900*R, floatAt 950*R, coinFlip captions * SCENE.READ
design_constants.renderer: Phaser.CANVAS default (phone-verified smooth); ?webgl=1 -> AUTO; ?diag=1 -> FPS HUD (js/diag.js)
design_constants.engine_balance: CONSUMPTION_MULT=1.0; HANDCUFFS never on teammates while teams_active

session_laws: labs (lifelab/platelab/framelab) need NO deploy — user views http://127.0.0.1:8000/... on this machine; game server runs on :8000, devcap sink on :8017
before giving the user ANY live link: curl-confirm the deploy finished (Render ~2min)
SELF-AUDIT every design sample: screenshot + zoom at REAL size, judge aesthetics/readability, iterate BEFORE presenting — shipping unlooked-at designs burned trust twice
film discipline gate: runner.html moments must be DONE with viol=0; sheets land in %TEMP%/sr_devcap
browser automation CANNOT judge motion (rAF-throttled when occluded) — force states via window.__lab/__scene JS injection for frames; user judges motion live
red = danger ONLY; faces sacred (alpha only, never tint); every menu opens from a tapped icon; copy must match engine truth
atomic commit per item; push only on user's word; master and uiv2-client always synced together
preference choices -> AskUserQuestion; frustration -> stop and diagnose with ONE atomic question
